rawDiagnostics.ruleName: Wrap Child Callback Props in useCallback
rawDiagnostics.message: Callback prop passed inline to child component without React.useCallback wrapper.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Wrap event handler functions passed as props to child components in React.useCallback.

rawDiagnostics.ruleName: Inline Anonymous Callbacks in Render Scope
rawDiagnostics.message: Inline anonymous arrow function defined in render scope (loop or non-loop) causing re-instantiation on every render.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Extract callback function or pass item ID to memoized event handler.

rawDiagnostics.ruleName: Stable List Key Prop Assignment
rawDiagnostics.message: Array index assigned as list key prop causing component re-ordering and state bugs.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Assign a unique stable identifier (item.id) to list key props instead of array index.
rawDiagnostics.evidence: Real AST (TypeScript compiler): JsxAttribute "key" at app/(dashboard)/pricing/page.tsx:82 resolves to the enclosing .map() callback's index parameter

rawDiagnostics.ruleName: useSearchParams Without a Suspense Boundary
rawDiagnostics.message: useSearchParams() called with no <Suspense> boundary visible in this file.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Wrap the component that calls useSearchParams() in a <Suspense> boundary (ideally around the smallest subtree that needs it) so the rest of the route can still be prerendered. Evidence: Next.js official documentation, useSearchParams reference and "Missing Suspense boundary with useSearchParams" -- https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-search-params, https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/missing-suspense-with-csr-bailout.
